scenes.name: glass-through-the-window
scenes.prompt: We glide sideways through the tall oval opening in an intricate ivory mineral lattice. The curved ribs and tiny nested chambers are made from translucent opal, milky crystal, rose-pink glass and fine silver. Cyan light shines from the deep spaces behind the ivory shell, rose-magenta crystal membranes stretch between delicate webs of tiny faceted ribs. Warm brass is becoming cool iridescent mineral. A fantastically detailed impossible crystalline garden, sculptural surfaces, luminous translucent depth, minute filaments and prismatic caustics. The large oval opening stays clear while nearby latticework passes across the foreground. No people, no letters, no frame.

scenes.name: the-crystalline-garden
scenes.prompt: An expansive higher-dimensional garden of translucent opalescent crystal and rose-magenta glass, viewed through sweeping pale mineral arches. Cyan and violet light glow through the deep open chambers. Intricate self-similar lattice, thin branching crystal filaments, thousands of tiny jewel cavities, suspended faceted polyhedra connected by delicate silver membranes, miniature emerald gardens nested inside some crystalline cells. Clear luminous spaces separate the floating sculptural forms. We glide laterally past an immense curved ivory rib and look into the open crystalline world beyond. Extraordinary intricacy, prismatic light, layered depth, dreamy surreal mineral sculpture. No people, no text, no gold city.

motion_note.intent: Use the actual upright oval window to glide sideways out of the close ivory lattice. Let a broad plane turn reveal the crystalline garden while forward travel gradually hands over to lateral movement.
